messages:
marina (Partnerships): Hey team — kicking off Almaty (Kazakhstan) marketplace onboarding with KazCloud. Primary asks: quota + KMS integration + GPU SKU entitlements. Target go-live: 2024-10-02. Can KazCloud confirm A100v4 availability and marketplace listing ETA?

vasiliy (KazCloud): Hi! We have A100v4 on the roadmap for Q3 but can reserve a small pool for you. Marketplace listing depends on KazCloud legal review — estimate 3 weeks after we hand over the listing pack.

samir (CloudOps): Re: quota — please provide desired vGPU count, burst policy, and expected QPS. I can pre-submit quota requests to CSP partner portal once we have numbers.

marina (Partnerships): Suggested start config: 8x A100v4 (reserved), burst to 16 for first 2 wks. QPS estimate: 120 p95 requests/minute for inference (short-turn chat). Will that work?

vasiliy (KazCloud): 8 reserved + burst to 16 is feasible. Need SLA tier selection — standard vs enterprise. Enterprise requires KMS + audit logs which adds 1 week.

elena (Legal): @vasiliy can you confirm what KMS provider you integrate with? We need a data residency + key custody agreement. If they support customer-managed keys (CMK) via CloudKMS/HSM, we can sign quicker.

vasiliy (KazCloud): We support CloudKMS-compatible HSM and can do HSM-backed CMK. We'll share integration spec by EOD tomorrow.

ash (GTM): Quick ask — marketing/announcement timeline: we'd prefer a joint blog + one-pager, aim to publish the week after go-live. Legal review on PR needs 5 business days. @marina please confirm owner for announcement assets.

marina (Partnerships): I'll own the partner one-pager. @ash will own the blog. Need final marketplace listing copy from KazCloud too.

samir (CloudOps): Submitting initial quota payload now — sample below, please confirm numbers:

```
{
  "region": "kz-almaty-1",
  "sku": "A100_v4",
  "reserved_instances": 8,
  "burst_capacity": 8,
  "expected_qps": 120,
  "kms_integration": "HSM-CMK"
}
```

vasiliy (KazCloud): Confirmed. We'll also need a contact for marketplace onboarding (legal + billing). I'll add our onboarding lead to the thread tomorrow.

elena (Legal): Once we get KMS spec, I’ll draft a minimal addendum for key custody and data residency acceptance. Can we aim to sign within 10 business days after spec?

marina (Partnerships): Timeline check: spec by EOD tomorrow, legal addendum drafted within 3 business days after spec, marketplace listing ready 3 weeks after listing pack, go-live target 2024-10-02. Sounds tight but doable if everyone hits deadlines.

ash (GTM): Noted — will prepare blog outline and a short partner quote template to speed PR review.

deploy-bot: deploy request created: /deploy region=kz-almaty-1 env=staging cluster=kazcloud-staging — build #402.

marina (Partnerships): Action items: 1) @vasiliy share KMS spec + billing contact (due EOD tomorrow). 2) @samir submit quota request with payload above (done). 3) @elena prep addendum after spec (3bd). 4) @ash collab on blog outline (this week). Will follow up in a quick sync Friday if needed. :thumbsup:
